what: Baidu runs China's largest search engine. It also owns iQIYI, a video streaming service, operates the Apollo Go robotaxi fleet, and sells AI cloud services built around its Ernie models.
customers: Chinese advertisers buying search and feed advertising, enterprises buying AI cloud services, and consumers using its apps and robotaxis.
money: cloud computing and AI model services
moat: The default search habit of hundreds of millions of Chinese users, plus one of the few domestic large language model and chip stacks built independently of American suppliers.
risks: It reported a loss in the latest period after investment write-downs
Search advertising revenue is being taken by short video platforms
Chinese regulatory and geopolitical risk affects US-listed Chinese shares
Robotaxi expansion consumes cash with no profit yet
opportunities: Analysts see large upside, with a median target well above the current price
Cash of about $28 billion against $17 billion of debt
Apollo Go operates one of the largest robotaxi fleets in the world by rides
watch: AI Cloud revenue growth and whether advertising revenue stabilises.
